svg.title: Uploaded transactions: preview, review and atomic save
svg.desc: Eight steps from file validation to committed reviewed transactions, merchant-history recurrence backfill and retry receipt. Preview is read-only. Saving preserves final review choices without redetection. Database failures roll back rows, backfill and receipt together.

g.text: File upload → review → atomic database save
Server authenticates every request and owns the user identity
1. Validate and parse the file
2. Suggest canonical categories
3. Deduplicate; detect recurrence
4. User reviews, edits and selects rows
5. Revalidate selected rows
6. Begin transaction; lock and recheck
7. Save rows + history tags + retry receipt
8. Commit; return counts and refresh
CSV / TSV / TXT / XLS / XLSX; maximum 500 rows
Preference → file category → merchant → AI if unresolved
Use owned history + included rows; read-only preview
Unassigned allowed; stable source-ID repeats blocked
Check row fields, categories and duplicate review freshness
Duplicate conflict: roll back and return to review
Use final reviewed tags; all writes commit or roll back
Unchanged retry returns receipt, not duplicate inserts
Invalid
Conflict
AI failure leaves categories reviewable. Final database failure saves no batch rows.
Source fields stay authoritative; AI does not rewrite dates, amounts or row identities.
